artifacts.notes: The complete uncorrected optical text layer of page 2, the whole page including the editorial under the headline and the adjacent leaders, and nothing beyond it. Uncorrected optical character recognition, unaccompanied here by any page image: a wording taken from it is a lead until checked against an image.
artifacts.rights_basis: The newspaper issue was published in 1890 and is in the public domain in the United States by date. The digital surrogate was made for the National Digital Newspaper Program, a partnership of the Library of Congress and the National Endowment for the Humanities: a faithful photographic reproduction of a public-domain page adds no original authorship, and a machine-generated optical text layer over it originates none either, originality being required by Feist Publications, Inc. v. Rural Telephone Service Co., 499 U.S. 340, 345 (1991). The bytes are retained here under the project-wide retention default.

One 1890 issue is registered here, for an editorial that reprints Galatians 6:9 with a cash prize in place of the harvest. A locus is issue date, page and column.
